findings.finding: In an exploratory aggregate check against study CC-5013-PK-001 (single 25 mg dose), the Hughes model under-predicted group-mean exposure about 2.2-fold in the 30-50 mL/min group and about 2.6-fold below 30 mL/min, and under-predicted terminal half-life (observed about 9-11 h vs about 5-6 h simulated). The 50-80 mL/min and >80 mL/min groups were consistent with the model.
findings.warning: Creatinine clearance is below 50 mL/min. An external check found this model under-predicts lenalidomide exposure here by roughly 2 to 3 fold; treat the curve and band as likely too low.
findings.robustness: Same classification in all four prespecified scenarios.
findings.consequence: Reported as a warning on every covariate estimate below the threshold. Calculations still run; nothing is corrected or hidden.
